_what: Pinned prices for providers that do NOT return a cost in the response. A cost returned by the provider always wins over this file.
_rule: Never fetch prices at request time. Update this file as a dated, reviewed task; an unknown price is loud on purpose.

deepseek.notes: Off-peak rates are half of peak. Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday; all other hours are off-peak. Billing follows the request time.

ovh.notes: AI Endpoints, OpenAI-compatible. VAT WARNING: the catalogue page displays prices including the VAT of the visitor's country (the English page shows UK VAT). Check the French, ex-VAT view before this map is used for a real invoice, and update the numbers here if they differ.
ovh.model_ids: The keys below are the lowercase, hyphenated ids used by the API. Confirm with GET /v1/models on the endpoint before onboarding a client: a string that does not match stays 'unknown' and loud, which is the safe failure.
ovh.not_priced_yet: whisper-large-v3 (0.00004083 EUR/second) and whisper-large-v3-turbo (0.00001278 EUR/second) are billed PER SECOND, not per token. The ledger has no duration column yet, so they are deliberately absent: absent means loud, a wrong unit would mean silently wrong. Add them with a duration-aware row or not at all.

openai_compatible:deepseek-flash._why: DeepSeek's own API, reached as an openai_compatible endpoint — no cost in the response, so it is priced from the canonical table above. An alias, not a copy: one place to update when DeepSeek changes its prices.

ovh:qwen3-embedding-8b._note: Embedding model: input only. The zero output rate is a real rate, not a missing price.

ollama:*._note: Local inference: no marginal token cost. Tokens are still counted — they are real capacity, and the client may be paying for the machine.

local:*._note: Self-hosted inference (vLLM and friends): no marginal cost in this ledger; the machine appears as an INFRASTRUCTURE line.
